title: 衛星地面站通訊鏈路
summary: 以衛星鏈路預算、都卜勒與接收窗口串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect satellite link budgets, doppler and contact windows through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 任務資料流：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Mission data flows: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「任務資料流」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For mission data flows, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「任務資料流」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：遙測、任務資料與指令具有不同權限和時限。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留頻率，只改斜距與傳播損失。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「軌道與可見性」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around mission data flows, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Telemetry, mission data and commands have different permissions/deadlines. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat orbit and visibility as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 保留頻率，只改斜距與傳播損失。 比較「任務資料流」與「軌道與可見性」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Compare whether evidence for mission data flows and orbit and visibility supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 自由空間損失只取決於頻率，與距離無關。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Free-space loss depends only on frequency, not distance. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「任務資料流」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for mission data flows. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 遙測、任務資料與指令具有不同權限和時限。
knowledge.textEn: Telemetry, mission data and commands have different permissions/deadlines.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「軌道與可見性」：軌道幾何決定可見窗口與斜距。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「任務資料流」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring orbit and visibility: Orbital geometry determines visibility windows and slant range. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove mission data flows passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 保留頻率，只改斜距與傳播損失。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 2 GHz、1000 km 自由空間，FSPL=92.45+20log10(2)+20log10(1000)=158.47 dB；EIRP 50 dBW、接收增益 30 dBi、其他損失 2 dB，接收約 −80.47 dBW。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 2 GHz over 1000 km: FSPL=158.47 dB; EIRP=50 dBW, receive gain=30 dBi and other losses=2 dB give approximately −80.47 dBW.

quiz.question: 針對「任務資料流」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of mission data flows?
options: 遙測、任務資料與指令具有不同權限和時限。
自由空間損失只取決於頻率，與距離無關。
只檢查「軌道與可見性」，便可取代「任務資料流」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Telemetry, mission data and commands have different permissions/deadlines.
Free-space loss depends only on frequency, not distance.
Checking orbit and visibility alone replaces verification specific to mission data flows.
quiz.explanation: 遙測、任務資料與指令具有不同權限和時限。 相鄰的「軌道與可見性」有不同責任：軌道幾何決定可見窗口與斜距。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Telemetry, mission data and commands have different permissions/deadlines. Neighboring orbit and visibility has a different role: Orbital geometry determines visibility windows and slant range. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 任務資料流：對照試驗與證據

steps.objective: 針對「任務資料流」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For mission data flows, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「遙測、任務資料與指令具有不同權限和時限。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：保留頻率，只改斜距與傳播損失。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「軌道與可見性」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。

Evaluate the principle: Telemetry, mission data and commands have different permissions/deadlines. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from orbit and visibility to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.observationEn: Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Compare whether evidence for mission data flows and orbit and visibility supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 自由空間損失只取決於頻率，與距離無關。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Free-space loss depends only on frequency, not distance. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「任務資料流」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

steps.titleEn: Effective radiated power: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「EIRP」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For effective radiated power, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「EIRP」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：EIRP 結合發射功率、損耗與天線增益。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留頻率，只改斜距與傳播損失。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「接收 G/T」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around effective radiated power, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: EIRP combines transmitter power, losses and antenna gain. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat receive g/t as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.observationEn: Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Compare whether evidence for effective radiated power and receive g/t supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 天線增益足夠就不需追蹤都卜勒。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
